snippet.title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter - Official Gameplay Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter, a cooking beat 'em up arcade action game developed by 3R Games. Players will fight enemy after enemy on the streets while ensuring they're properly nourished with delicious food in nick of time. Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
